audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Qiyana all seven level-chart rows and rated the lane HARD 8/10, while content win[0..6], every content why, and the packet levelChart all say Xerath — over 1426 games at 58.13%.
audit.why: Qiyana's damage starts at 525 (Q) and her only reach into you is Audacity at 650 on an 11s cooldown; your Q charges from beyond it and your W is 1000. She has no ranged answer at all before she commits.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side moved to Xerath to agree with win[0..6]; diff, tone, diffRating and the two difficulty strings brought in line with the win rate.

audit.why: Lost Chapter, level 6 and Luden's are your spikes; hers is level 6 Supreme Display of Talent on a flat 120s, and her element pickups off walls and river brush.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page put the dash on the wrong slot — 'Terrashape (E) dash' — in spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[0]. And the interaction that decides your level 6 was absent: Qiyana's Q and R both cancel your Rite of the Arcane mid-channel.
audit.why: Terrashape is W (1100 range, 7s, dash plus element and it creates terrain); Audacity is E (650, 11/10/9/8/7s, dash to an enemy). Your R is flagged channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it, and both Elemental Wrath/Edge of Ixtal (Q, hardCC) and Supreme Display of Talent (R, knockup + hardCC) qualify.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere they appeared; the channel-cancel rule written into breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the packet reported zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Audacity's 11s at rank 1 is the only window that matters — spent, she cannot reach you at all; Terrashape is 7s.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the 'step up on that window' rule written in, plus the R-channel warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: 21 fields called Qiyana 'he/his'; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields fixed; both bled bullets rewritten to their titles.

audit.why: matchup-lint reported MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE / HEDGING on these fields; cooldowns and ranges taken from champ-data/_kits.
audit.corrected: Pronouns matched to the enemy champion; bled trade text replaced with field-specific advice; cooldown lines given real per-rank numbers.

edits.before: Through 3-5 you keep chipping her while she looks for an angle; her kill pattern is Terrashape (E) dash plus enhanced Q and Supreme Display of Talent (R), which you counter by keeping minions between you and pre-slowing with W. Slow-push and ward river so her element pickups and jungle ganks find nothing.

notes: Same structural defect as pantheon: the full layer read Qiyana on all seven chart rows while content win[0..6] and the packet both read Xerath, against a 58.13% win rate over 1426 games — sides flipped to Xerath, no paired win[N] edits needed (they would have been no-ops). diff/tone/diffRating and both difficulty strings moved with it; carryRating left at 8.5/10 since Qiyana remains a genuine snowball threat off a single pick. Real ability-slot error corrected: the page had 'Terrashape (E)' in three places — Terrashape is W (1100 range, 7s, dash + element + terrain), Audacity is E (650, 11/10/9/8/7s). The brief's missing interaction (her Q and R cancel your Rite of the Arcane channel) is now on the page. packet.sequencingCues was 0; concrete cooldown-gated lines added.
